description: Create a FAQai document from a public web page or website, then generate RAG datasets from it — no local file needed. Fetches a single page by default; set crawl=true (or max_pages>1) to crawl same-domain pages (via sitemap or, if none, a breadth-first walk), respecting robots.txt and per-plan page caps. Static HTML only — JavaScript-rendered pages may yield little/no content. Consumes monthly page quota (metered by extracted content); the tool checks remaining quota first. After ingest with auto_process (default), poll get_processing_status until the document is 'completed', then call list_datasets. Crawls run asynchronously and may take longer than single-file uploads.

auto_process.description: Start dataset generation immediately after ingest (default true). Set false to ingest only; processing can be started later with process_document.

chunking.description: Chunking profile: a preset name (balanced ~400 tokens, fine_grained ~200, large_context ~800) or custom values (paid plans).

contextual_enrichment.description: Add an AI context header and hypothetical questions to each RAG chunk for better retrieval (paid plans). Consumes enrichment units from the monthly quota.

crawl.description: Crawl multiple same-domain pages instead of just the given URL (default false). Discovery uses the site's sitemap when available, else a same-domain breadth-first walk.

generation_context.description: Audience/use-case steering for dataset generation (paid plans): a preset id (customer_support_bot, internal_knowledge_base, developer_docs_assistant, sales_enablement, compliance_legal) or free text like 'chatbot for hotel guests'.

max_pages.description: Maximum pages to crawl. Clamped to the plan cap (Free 5, Basic 50, Starter 150, Pro 500). Setting >1 implies crawl=true.

name.description: Display name for the document (defaults to the page title or URL)

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the page or site to ingest, e.g. https://example.com/docs
